Application Data.NAME: Johnson Plumbing & HVAC Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Johnson Plumbing & HVAC Solutions specializes in residential and light commercial plumbing and HVAC services, focusing on the installation and repair of boilers and furnaces. We operate exclusively in low- to medium-risk environments and ensure compliance with all relevant safety regulations. Our team is trained and adheres to OSHA standards, with regular maintenance of equipment and ongoing employee training to uphold safety practices. We do not engage in any hazardous material handling or demolition activities. Additionally, we offer ancillary services such as the installation of carbon monoxide detectors and boiler chemical treatments, fully compliant with regulatory standards. We work with qualified subcontractors for specialized tasks, ensuring they carry appropriate insurance and adhere to indemnification agreements.

Underwriting Guidelines:
– Residential and light commercial contractors specializing in boiler and furnace installa-
tion and repair, with operations limited to low- to medium-risk environments.
– Contractors with no involvement in demolition, blasting, asbestos or lead paint abate-
ment, or other hazardous material handling.
– Firms demonstrating strong safety programs, including OSHA compliance, regular em-
ployee training, and documented equipment maintenance.
– Businesses with a clean or minimal claims history, showing proactive risk management.
• Acceptable:
– Contractors who utilize subcontractors for specialized tasks, provided subcontractors
carry appropriate insurance and indemnification agreements are in place.
– Firms that perform ancillary services related to boiler and furnace systems, such as
installation of associated alarm systems (e.g., carbon monoxide detectors) or chemical
treatments for boilers, assuming full regulatory compliance.
